catalog.rule: An entry is available only when its latest binding evaluates to valid under this policy and the published fields equal the approved report field by field. A valid evaluation with a differing configured entry withholds the entry and names the field.
catalog.caveat: An available entry means the policy held at the recorded checkpoints and time. The roles above say who controls each account; this catalog does not establish independent review or adoption.
